#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /workspace/toolchains/activate.sh
cd /workspace/openjdk-jdk27u
python3 make/scripts/bench-integer-conversion.py \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/00ff7add \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/integer-interpreter-only-f415a08 '/workspace/jmh-1.37/*' \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-support/integer-final-qualified \
 --original-commit 00ff7addb7b9f4cb5f7f5c335b919b4e4dc15ef8 \
 --head-commit f415a0837503f2f1e3eae8d6fb9602cdd5ad5c33 \
 --variants original default --tiers c2 c1 interpreter --sizes short wide \
 --benchmarks 'org.openjdk.bench.java.lang.DecimalIntegerConversion.(intString|longString|longAppendUTF16|longConcatUTF16|parseInt|parseLong|parseUnsignedInt|parseUnsignedLong|rawIntLatin1|rawLongUTF16)$' \
 > /workspace/fast-float-2-support/integer-final-qualified-driver.log 2>&1
cd /workspace/openjdk-jdk27u
python3 make/scripts/bench-integer-conversion.py \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/00ff7add \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/integer-interpreter-only-f415a08 '/workspace/jmh-1.37/*' \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-support/integer-final-utf16-qualified \
 --original-commit 00ff7addb7b9f4cb5f7f5c335b919b4e4dc15ef8 \
 --head-commit f415a0837503f2f1e3eae8d6fb9602cdd5ad5c33 \
 --variants original default --tiers interpreter c1 c2 --sizes short wide \
 --no-compact-strings \
 --benchmarks 'org.openjdk.bench.java.lang.DecimalIntegerConversion.(parseInt|parseLong|parseUnsignedInt|parseUnsignedLong)$' \
 > /workspace/fast-float-2-support/integer-final-utf16-driver.log 2>&1
python3 make/scripts/bench-decimal-review.py \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/00ff7add \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/integer-interpreter-only-f415a08 '/workspace/jmh-1.37/*' \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-support/zmij-main-pin-qualified \
 --original-commit 00ff7addb7b9f4cb5f7f5c335b919b4e4dc15ef8 \
 --head-commit f415a0837503f2f1e3eae8d6fb9602cdd5ad5c33 \
 --variants original default optout --tiers interpreter c1 c2 --cpu 1 --duration 500ms \
 --benchmarks 'org.openjdk.bench.java.lang.ZmijFormatting.(doubleRandom|floatRandom|doubleShortInteger|floatShortInteger|doublePutUtf16|floatPutUtf16)$' \
 > /workspace/fast-float-2-support/zmij-main-pin-qualified-driver.log 2>&1
taskset -c 1 env FAST_FLOAT_BENCHMARKS='org.openjdk.bench.java.lang.FastFloatParsing.(parseDoubleShortInput|parseFloatShortInput|parseDoubleDecimal|parseFloatDecimal|parseDoubleLongInput|parseFloatLongInput)$' \
 bash make/scripts/bench-fast-float.sh \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-images/integer-interpreter-only-f415a08 '/workspace/jmh-1.37/*' \
 /workspace/fast-float-2-support/fast-float-final-qualified \
 -f 3 -wi 3 -i 3 -w 500ms -r 500ms -prof gc -foe true \
 > /workspace/fast-float-2-support/fast-float-final-qualified-driver.log 2>&1
